title: Soviet divers meet tall humanoids at Lake Baikal

tellings.quote: Do you know the story of like Soviet divers going down to like look for something and they get petr- like they meet these tall tall human- I mean, it's

plain: Soviet divers are said to have gone down into Lake Baikal in 1982 to look for something and met very tall humanlike beings under the water. Michels raises it himself, as a question to a treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, and breaks off mid-sentence before saying where the story comes from or what happened next. If it were true, beings of some kind would be living or working underwater in Siberia's great lake.
